purpose: Teach: イースト/アーチ/大リーグ/サーモン/マイレージ/聖歌/ダイアナ/カッパ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがイースト菌の働きを実験で見せて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, Daddy's going to show you how yeast works with a little experiment.
lines.style: Bright, inviting opening, dangling the treat. Warm motherly pace with a smile behind it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと公園のアーチ橋の写真撮ったよ
lines.en: Mommy, I took pictures of the arch bridge in the park with Daddy!
lines.style: Rushing in eager and breathless, words spilling over each other. Proud bounce on the ending.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが大リーグの試合中継を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Daddy's watching the big league game on TV right now.
lines.style: Gentle heads-up tone, slightly hushed like not to disturb the game. Even, easy pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサーモンのムニエル食べたよ
lines.en: Mommy, I ate salmon meunière with Daddy!
lines.style: Delighted announcement, carefully proud of the fancy dish name. Quick and bright to the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが航空マイレージを上手に使ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: You know, Sho, Daddy's awfully clever with his airline miles.
lines.style: Admiring little laugh under the words, confiding tone. Relaxed pace, affection warming the close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクリスマスの聖歌をカラオケで歌ったよ
lines.en: Mommy, I sang Christmas hymns at karaoke with Daddy!
lines.style: Practically singing the line, giggly and loud. Racing pace, joy bursting through every word.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがダイアナ妃の伝記映画を観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, Daddy's watching a film about Princess Diana's life.
lines.style: Softer, more thoughtful register, a small reflective pause before the princess's name. Slow, gentle finish.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとカッパ、つまり河童巻きを食べたよ
lines.en: Mommy, I ate kappa rolls with Daddy — you know, the cucumber sushi!
lines.style: Tripping excitedly over the explanation, then a big satisfied grin on the finish.
